DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Erythema Toxicum.

Thank you for the history; the description of a generalized erythematous maculopapular rash with pustules that spares the palms and soles is classic for Erythema Toxicum. I will proceed with the blood work I ordered to rule out infection, and if results are normal, no further testing is needed.
